description:
Made only for customizing, 'Beast Sword' is played by Yeo-ri, an adult who plays the game with excessive immersion. She meets a newbie player named Lex, who appears outwardly to her taste and eventually succeeds in getting married to him. "To commemorate the wedding we decided to meet at an off-site to make a perfume, but why was my co-worker, who I'm uncomfortable with at work, at the meeting place...?"

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=812412), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9881908)
